correctness.rationale: Deleting the first, middle or last adjacent pair from abcd gives cd, ad or ab, so at least ⌈q²/3⌉ words are needed. I checked the seven local templates by this exact rule: the 2×3, 3×2, 3×3, 3×4 and 4×3 templates hit every cell once; 2×2 doubles exactly local cells (0,0) and (1,0), and 4×4 doubles exactly (1,3) and (3,3). All templates have three distinct outputs per word. For q≡0 mod 3 the Cartesian blocks are all 3×3; for q≡1 or 2 there is one exceptional square of side 4 or 2, respectively, including q=4 or 2 with no other blocks. Source words from different rectangles cannot coincide, since their row and column coordinates identify the rectangle. Thus the block partition lifts the finite certificate to all q≥2 and proves both optimality and the multiplicities of the exhibited family. No claim about the multiplicities of every optimal cover is needed. The uploaded script was not executed; the required finite certificate was checked by direct enumeration.
